name: single-leg-hop
instructions:
1. Setup in a comfortable athletic position with the feet at roughly shoulder width apart and your arms by your sides.
2. Shift your weight to one leg and lift the unsupported leg off the floor.
3. Descend quickly to a quarter squat position and extend your arms behind your torso.
4. Drive upwards and land softly by absorbing the impact with the hips and knees.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
